The '''2026 Retro League Event 3''' was the third event of the [[2026 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]]. It was played 9 August – 20 September 2026 in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format.<ref name="t86346" /> [[Andrew Bethell]] won, beating [[Kevin Bing]] in a Final Confrontation.<ref name="email20261010" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 9 August – 20 September 2026
* '''Players:''' 65 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Bethell]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t86346" />
